verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Cake Equity. What it does document is an MCP integration that lets external clients such as Claude, Codex or Cursor query the cap table read-only. That is a different capability (an MCP server for outside agents), and being read-only it also does not allow delegating tasks, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
